_comment: Copy this to tools/screener_config.json (gitignored) and put your screener.in sessionid in .secrets/screener_cookie.txt. Give each source ONE of: raw_query (a query string, no saved screen needed — RECOMMENDED), screen_url (a saved screen's page URL), or url (a direct CSV/XLSX link). kind = 'screener' or 'stage2'.

sources.raw_query: Market Capitalization > 1000 AND Return over 6months > -1000 AND Return over 1year > -1000
sources.name: Market cap > 1000 (broad market)
sources._note: TESTED LIVE against screener.in on 30 Aug 2026. Results, with the bare 'Market Capitalization > 1000' baseline at 1,612 names:  Volume > 0 -> WORKS, adds a 'Vol 1d' column, costs only 10 names (1,602).  The five return filters -> WORK, add '6mth return %' and '1Yr return %', but cost 127 names (1,485) because anything without a full year of history fails the 1-year filter - which means RECENT LISTINGS DROP OUT. 'DMA 150' -> DOES NOT EXIST ('Unknown word: dma 150'), so Weinstein's 30-week line cannot be had from screener at all; only DMA 50 and DMA 200 are available. The -1000 thresholds filter nothing; they exist purely because screener only exports a ratio the query references. IF THE 127 LOST NAMES MATTER (they include sub-1-year IPOs), the better route is to add the columns to a SAVED screen via EDIT COLUMNS instead of filtering for them - a saved screen carries its own column set with no exclusion.

_column_note: screener.in appends AT MOST TWO query terms as export columns, in the order they appear in the query. Novel terms beyond the second are filtered on but NOT exported. So you get any two of {Return over 6months, Return over 1year, Volume} - never all three. 6months+1year is chosen because the RS composite needs r3m+r6m+r1y together to use IBD quarterly weighting; with either missing it silently falls back to 0.5*r3m+0.3*r1m+0.2*r1w. Reordering the query changes which two arrive - verified 2026-09-09 by swapping them and re-exporting. To get all three you must add the column on the SAVED SCREEN via EDIT COLUMNS, which changes the screener account config, not this file.
